noeuds.schema: Inputs: Object A, Object B, Condition  →  Output: True / False
noeuds.role: Calculates the distance in pixels between object A and object B.
noeuds.exemple: check whether the player is close enough to open a door.

noeuds.role: Rotates object A so that it faces object B.
noeuds.exemple: a defense turret aiming at the player.

noeuds.role: Finds the nearest object or a random one so you can use it next.
